skill.name: mobile-debugging
skill.description: Guides debugging for React Native and Expo apps, including Metro cache issues, native module errors, device logs, performance checks, and crash investigation.
skill.summary: Troubleshoot React Native and Expo app issues with focused diagnostics and cautious command guidance.
skill.author: BabakBar

security_audit.summary: Most static backtick findings are Markdown fences or TypeScript template literals, not executable backtick execution. Real risk remains from Bash-enabled troubleshooting commands that delete caches, reset simulators, inspect device logs, and force-kill Metro processes. No prompt injection, credential exfiltration, or malicious network behavior was found.

remediation.issue: Destructive cleanup commands are shown without approval steps.
remediation.suggestion: Add explicit user confirmation before deleting caches, reinstalling dependencies, resetting simulators, or stopping emulators.

remediation.issue: The Metro port command force-kills processes selected by command substitution.
remediation.suggestion: Show the process first, ask the user to confirm the PID, and prefer graceful termination before force kill.

remediation.issue: Device log commands may expose private application data.
remediation.suggestion: Tell users to redact tokens, customer data, and private API responses before sharing logs with an AI assistant.

content.user_title: Debug React Native and Expo Apps
content.value_statement: Mobile app debugging often wastes time across Metro, native builds, logs, and device tooling. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code a focused checklist for React Native and Expo issues.
actual_capabilities: Guides Metro cache and module resolution troubleshooting.
Lists checks for iOS simulators and Android emulators.
Explains how to gather Metro, Xcode, and Logcat evidence.
Provides patterns for render performance and memory leak checks.
Maps common React Native errors to likely causes.
limitations: Does not replace platform documentation or vendor support.
May require Expo, Watchman, Xcode, Android Studio, or adb.
Some commands can delete caches or reset devices and need approval.
Cannot diagnose production crashes without logs and reproduction steps.

use_cases.title: Resolve Local Build Failures
use_cases.description: Diagnose Metro, native module, and simulator problems during React Native development.

use_cases.title: Prepare Reproducible Bug Reports
use_cases.description: Collect symptoms, platform details, and safe log excerpts for mobile defects.

use_cases.title: Triage Crash And Performance Reports
use_cases.description: Review crash patterns, slow renders, and memory cleanup issues before assigning fixes.

prompt_templates.title: Diagnose A Metro Error
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the mobile-debugging skill to diagnose a Metro bundler error. Ask for the exact error before suggesting commands.

prompt_templates.title: Check Native Module Setup
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the mobile-debugging skill to review a native module failure. Compare iOS and Android symptoms before proposing cleanup steps.

prompt_templates.title: Investigate Slow Screens
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the mobile-debugging skill to trace a slow React Native screen. Focus on render time, memory cleanup, and recent changes.

prompt_templates.title: Plan A Cross-Platform Crash Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the mobile-debugging skill to plan a crash investigation for iOS and Android. Include safe log collection and approval checkpoints.

output_examples.input: Metro cannot resolve a module after files were moved.
output: Likely causes include a stale cache, changed import path, or missing dependency.
First verify the file path and package version.
Ask before deleting caches or reinstalling dependencies.

output_examples.input: The Android app crashes after adding a native package.
output: Compare the Android error with recent dependency changes.
Check native module compatibility and Gradle build output.
Collect only the relevant Logcat excerpt and redact private data.

output_examples.input: A screen feels slow after a navigation change.
output: Review recent component changes and repeated renders.
Check cleanup for timers, subscriptions, and async work.
Use performance evidence before changing architecture.

best_practices: Share exact errors, platform, device type, and recent changes first.
Ask before deleting caches, resetting simulators, or killing processes.
Redact tokens, user data, and private API responses from logs.
anti_patterns: Running every cleanup command before reading the error message.
Pasting full device logs that contain secrets or customer data.
Resetting simulators or dependencies without checking local impact.

faq.question: What apps does this skill support?
faq.answer: It supports React Native and Expo apps during local debugging and triage.

faq.question: Can it fix Metro bundler issues?
faq.answer: It can guide diagnosis for cache, dependency, and module resolution problems.

faq.question: Does it run commands automatically?
faq.answer: The skill lists commands, but destructive steps should require user approval.

faq.question: Can it analyze mobile crash logs?
faq.answer: It can help interpret relevant logs when sensitive data is redacted first.

faq.question: Does it cover performance debugging?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes render timing, memory cleanup, and common slow screen checks.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists compatibility with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
